description: ONE ticker's complete insider record for a year, with open-market buys, open-market sales and 10b5-1 plan sales kept apart and never netted. Complete, so an empty buy side is a real finding. Market-wide is get_insider_trades. Analyst plan.

ticker.description: The issuer's symbol, e.g. 'INTC'. US-listed common stock: only US registrants file Form 4.
